question.text: What is the quotation method for GOI bond futures?

answer.text: Price-based quotation (clean price) per Rs. 100 face value

explanation.text: The Logic: GOI bond futures use a price-based quotation, with trading and settlement at the clean price for a face value of Rs. 100. Cash and futures market prices are both quoted per Rs. 100 face value. The Trap: Yield-based quotation is not used for GOI bond futures; discount rate quotation applies to T-Bills; dirty price (clean price plus accrued interest) is used for actual bond settlement, not for futures quotation. Note: The cost-of-carry relationship (cash price + financing cost - income on cash position) links the clean futures price to the spot bond price and accrued interest, as developed in the bond futures pricing pages.
